# Code of Conduct — Public Project

> **Note for maintainers:** This template is for projects affiliated with government bodies, public organizations, or civic entities subject to Montana open government laws. Replace bracketed placeholders before use.

## About this project

This project is maintained by or in support of **[ORGANIZATION NAME]**, a [public body / civic organization / government entity] operating in Montana. As a result, certain transparency obligations apply to this project and its participants.

## Public records notice

Contributions to this project — including issues, pull requests, comments, and other communications made through this repository — may constitute public records under the **Montana Public Records Act (MCA § 2-6-1001 et seq.)** and may be subject to public disclosure upon request.

**Do not submit:**
- Personally identifiable information you would not want disclosed publicly
- Confidential correspondence, legal advice, or privileged communications
- Information subject to HIPAA, FERPA, or other federal privacy protections
- Credentials, passwords, or sensitive configuration data

If you have questions about whether specific information is subject to disclosure, contact [ORGANIZATION NAME] before submitting.

## Open meetings

Deliberations and decisions made through this repository that relate to the official business of [ORGANIZATION NAME] may be subject to Montana's open meetings laws (**MCA § 2-3-201 et seq.**). Decisions of consequence should not be made solely through private GitHub communications.

## Making a public records request

To request records related to this project, contact:

**[ORGANIZATION NAME]**
[Address]
[City, MT ZIP]
[Email]
[Phone]

Requests should identify the records sought with reasonable specificity. A response will be provided within [X] business days as required by law.

## Our standards

**Expected behavior:**
- Conduct yourself as you would in a public meeting — with civility and respect
- Keep discussion focused on the project's public purpose
- Assume your communications may be read by any member of the public
- Be respectful of differing viewpoints and the communities this project serves

**Unacceptable behavior:**
- Harassment, intimidation, or discrimination in any form
- Sharing private or confidential information through public channels
- Using this repository to conduct business that should occur in properly noticed public meetings
- Other conduct that would reasonably be considered inappropriate in a public professional setting

## Enforcement

Instances of unacceptable behavior may be reported to [dogiakos@gmail.com](mailto:dogiakos@gmail.com). Reports will be reviewed and investigated promptly. Note that reports themselves may be subject to public records disclosure.

## Attribution

Behavioral standards adapted from the [Contributor Covenant v2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/). Public records provisions reflect Montana law as of 2025; consult legal counsel for your specific situation.
